answer_1.quote: We study the capacity of language models to learn k-hop reasoning tasks, where k = 2, 3, 4. By training a randomly initialized GPT2-style transformer on knowledge (e.g. Jennifer 's instructor is Robert) and knowledge-based questions (e.g. Who is the instructor of the instructor of Jennifer?), we study if such language models learn to generalize to questions that require novel combinations of learned facts.
